items: The pre-reform baseline can start now
The reform's effect waits for the data gate
A 5 to 8 month dose: report power first

notes: Three conclusions. First, the pre-reform profile and the old-threshold baseline can start now. Second, the new policy's effect has to wait until post-reform data are released. Third, with a dose of five to eight months by the end of 2026, I will report power before any coefficient. I welcome the committee's comments.
